scope: Review-only ecology and interaction candidates for the nine taxa whose representative images remain held pending species-level comparison.

taxonomyBasis.source: National Species List, National Institute of Biological Resources
taxonomyBasis.boundary: Taxon names and Korean common names are draft candidates until checked against the authoritative taxon records.

usageBoundary: Every asset remains in assets/insects/review. It is illustrative, not an observation record, and must not be used as a representative image or production asset.
